import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 300;
    static final int EMPTY = -1;
    static final int REACTION = -2;
    static final int HAZARD = -3;
    static final int SHELTER = EMPTY;

    static class Link {
        int u, v, reverse, current, limit;

        Link() {
            u = 0; v = 0; reverse = 0; current = 0; limit = 0;
        }

        Link(int a, int b, int r, int c, int l) {
            u = a; v = b; reverse = r; current = c; limit = l;
        }

        int spare() {
            return limit - current;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int V;
        List<Link>[] adj;
        Link[] par;
        int[] seen;

        FlowNetwork(int n) {
            V = n;
            adj = new List[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            par = new Link[n];
            seen = new int[n];
        }

        void link(int a, int b, int cap) {
            Link f = new Link(a, b, adj[b].size(), 0, cap);
            Link r = new Link(b, a, adj[a].size(), 0, 0);
            adj[a].add(f);
            adj[b].add(r);
        }

        void bidirect(int a, int b, int cap) {
            Link f = new Link(a, b, adj[b].size(), 0, cap);
            Link r = new Link(b, a, adj[a].size(), 0, cap);
            adj[a].add(f);
            adj[b].add(r);
        }

        boolean explore(int src, int dst) {
            Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
            Arrays.fill(par, null);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(src);
            seen[src] = 1;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int cur = q.poll();
                if (cur == dst) return true;
                for (Link e : adj[cur]) {
                    if (seen[e.v] == 0 && e.spare() > 0) {
                        seen[e.v] = 1;
                        par[e.v] = e;
                        q.offer(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int augment(int src, int dst) {
            int flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = dst; v != src; v = par[v].u) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, par[v].spare());
            }
            for (int v = dst; v != src; v = par[v].u) {
                Link e = par[v];
                e.current += flow;
                adj[e.v].get(e.reverse).current -= flow;
            }
            return flow;
        }

        long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long total = 0;
            while (explore(s, t)) {
                total += augment(s, t);
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int[][] layout = new int[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] capacity = new int[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][][] danger = new int[61][MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];

    static class Pos {
        int r, c, val;

        Pos(int x, int y, int n) {
            r = x; c = y; val = n;
        }

        boolean inGrid(int sz) {
            return r >= 0 && r < sz && c >= 0 && c < sz && layout[r][c] == EMPTY;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (this == obj) return true;
            if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
            Pos pos = (Pos) obj;
            return r == pos.r && c == pos.c;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(r, c);
        }
    }

    static boolean inBounds(int x, int y, int sz) {
        return new Pos(x, y, 0).inGrid(sz);
    }

    static final int[] dRow = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dCol = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static List<Pos> candidates = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Pos> exits = new ArrayList<>();

    static int classify(char c) {
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return EMPTY;
        if (c == 'Y') return REACTION;
        if (c == 'Z') return HAZARD;
        return -1;
    }

    static int digit(char c) {
        return c - '0';
    }

    static int distance(Pos start, Pos end, int sz) {
        boolean[][] seen = new boolean[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{0, start.r, start.c});
        seen[start.r][start.c] = true;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int t = cur[0];
            int r = cur[1];
            int c = cur[2];

            if (r == end.r && c == end.c) return t;
            if (danger[t][r][c] == 1) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dRow[k];
                int nc = c + dCol[k];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < sz && nc >= 0 && nc < sz && !seen[nr][nc] && layout[nr][nc] == EMPTY && danger[t][nr][nc] == 0) {
                    q.offer(new int[]{t + 1, nr, nc});
                    seen[nr][nc] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static void contaminate(int x, int y, int limit, int sz) {
        danger[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int t = 1; t <= limit; ++t) {
            for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < sz; ++j) {
                    if (danger[t-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        danger[t][i][j] = 1;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                            int ni = i + dRow[k];
                            int nj = j + dCol[k];
                            if (ni >= 0 && ni < sz && nj >= 0 && nj < sz && layout[ni][nj] == EMPTY) {
                                danger[t][ni][nj] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();

        Pos source = new Pos(0, 0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (classify(ch) == EMPTY && Character.isDigit(ch)) {
                    candidates.add(new Pos(i, j, digit(ch)));
                }
                layout[i][j] = classify(ch);
                if (layout[i][j] == HAZARD) {
                    source = new Pos(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (classify(ch) == SHELTER && Character.isDigit(ch)) {
                    exits.add(new Pos(i, j, digit(ch)));
                    capacity[i][j] = digit(ch);
                }
            }
        }

        FlowNetwork net = new FlowNetwork(MAX_SIZE);
        int terminal = MAX_SIZE - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < candidates.size(); ++i) {
            net.link(0, i*2 + 1, candidates.get(i).val);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < exits.size(); ++i) {
            net.link(i*2 + 2, terminal, exits.get(i).val);
        }

        contaminate(source.r, source.c, T, N);

        for (int i = 0; i < candidates.size(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < exits.size(); ++j) {
                int d = distance(candidates.get(i), exits.get(j), N);
                if (d <= T) {
                    net.link(i*2 + 1, j*2 + 2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(net.maxFlow(0, terminal));
    }
}
